keyword: how to watch the final four
claims: The 2026 Men's Final Four is on Saturday, April 4, 2026.
Coverage of the 2026 Men's Final Four starts around 6:00 p.m. ET.
Game 1 of the 2026 Final Four is UConn vs. Illinois at 6:09 p.m. ET on TBS/truTV.
Game 2 of the 2026 Final Four is Michigan vs. Arizona at ~8:49 p.m. ET on TBS/truTV.
The 2026 National Championship game is on April 6, 2026.
The 2026 Men's Final Four games feature Ian Eagle, Bill Raftery, Grant Hill, and Tracy Wolfson.
Sling TV offers Sling Orange which carries TBS, TNT, truTV.
Sling TV often has a Day Pass option.
The HBO Max Standard plan streams Turner Sports games (TBS, TNT, truTV).
Hulu + Live TV includes all networks needed for the tournament.
